title: Installer .github confinement
prose: The plugin installer must write only inside the consuming repo's .github/ tree. Every resolved destination passes Resolve-GithubConstrainedPath, which rejects any dest that escapes .github (traversal, rooted, or absolute). No install path may touch docs/, scripts/, schemas/, or any tree outside .github/.
description: Security boundary: a plugin manifest (untrusted for this purpose) can never cause a write outside .github/. Enforced by Resolve-GithubConstrainedPath and Test-Registry; covered by install/remove tests.
